summary: V22 — Team Broadcast Events + Multi-level Admin Roles. FULL PASS. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass (test_v22_broadcast_hierarchy.py). Owner scope=all recipient resolution, member 403 on broadcast=all attempt, read_only=true flag on recipient GET, PUT/DELETE 403 on recipient with 'sola lettura' msg, owner PUT ok, scope=subtree and scope=custom recipient lists correct, PUT /team/{id}/role owner→admin promotion & demote-back, admin scope=subtree ok, admin scope=all forbidden (403), admin POST /team creates nested user (parent_user_id=admin.user_id), GET /team/hierarchy returns {root:{children:[...]}, flat:[...]}. Cleanup verified: sub1@dalpastro.it re-verified as role=member post-run, all test appointments and nested user deleted. Frontend smoke (mobile 390x844, owner login): ap-broadcast-toggle visible on /appointment/new, toggling shows all 3 scope pills (all/subtree/custom), all 5 notify pills (5/15/30/60/120), custom scope reveals ap-broadcast-member-{uid} pills. No pageerrors on the flow. Non-blocking noise: 13x console warning 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' — pre-existing stray text node somewhere in the tab layout, not introduced by V22.

issues: React Native Web console warning repeated 13x: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>'. Pre-existing — indicates a bare whitespace/period string rendered outside a <Text> component. Grep for stray '.' or template-literal whitespace inside <View> in tabs/layout files. Low priority, harmless on native but noisy on web.

action_items: (Optional) Track down 'Unexpected text node: .' warning source — likely a stray `.` or unwrapped text between <View> children in a shared layout/header. Non-blocking.

team_hierarchy walks up parent chain via extra DB round-trips per user (potential N+1 for deep trees). Fine for current scale.
